content.rendered:
Luka Juhart is an accordion and chamber music teacher and leads a Studio for contemporary music at the Music Academy at the University of Ljubljana, Slovenia. He is also a leader of the department for contemporary music at the same Academy.  

He also teaches at diverse international master-classes.

Degrees offered:
Bachelor in Musical Arts
Master in Musical Arts
Master in Instrumental Education

Further information:
http://www.ag.uni-lj.si/
